name: Jaguar Paw
notes: Photo 1 is the main Jaguar Paw menu (Bites, Rolls, Bowls). Photo 3 is a separate holiday pop-up flyer with a Food/Comida section plus cocktails, wine, and beer (only Food/Comida items kept). Photos 2 and 4 are drink-only cafe menus for two different in-house coffee vendors (Morning Dew Libations Co. and Despertar Coffee Co.) with no food items, so per the drink-only rule they contributed no dishes. Dropped the 'add ons' line (shrimp tempura, soy paper, extra sauce) as modifiers.
